named-system-verdict.name: A named real system, a number, and a verdict
named-system-verdict.visual: cream evidence card / dark analysis panel over a moving bed (our own)
named-system-verdict.notes: THE ONLY ROW WITH FIRST-PARTY EVIDENCE. Our own audit: 3 videos -> 65 of 109 long-form subs; 11 of top 12 by CTR (4.4-9.5%). Independently, the two channels beating the agent-engineering lane on avgViews/subs (1.66x, 1.11x vs lane median 0.22x) both run this shape. Note the lane, not the format, is what failed there -- see the 2026-08-10 sweep.
